changes.summary: LeonardoMD shows the changes included in each new version at startup. You can hide the notice for that version or reopen it from the application menu.
Resize columns, rows and whole tables in Preview with the mouse or keyboard. Markdown documents migrate safely to MDLF to preserve table dimensions.
Improve document format and storage indicator contrast in light themes using the palette heading color.
Distinguish Leonardo files in wine, configure file colors globally or per project, and filter and sort the project file list.
Undo and redo document edits from the toolbar or keyboard, with separate history for each document and support for source, preview and form editing.
Preview and Split preserve the field presentation shown in Fill form.
Promote a chosen validated beta to stable while preserving its version and exact signed artifact, even when newer betas exist.
Form date fields offer a larger calendar in the active theme, with localized labels, keyboard navigation and a safe fallback for malformed locales, while preserving editable drafts.
Export Leonardo documents and form answers as Markdown with a loss warning and portable image handling.
Deleted files, folders and projects now move to Trash so they can be recovered.
Little Leonardo becomes read-only, preserves older work against cache overwrites and exports it for recovery; proprietary Git is retired while desktop synchronization and system Git remain available.
About, Release notes, confirmations and file selection attach as modal sheets; file actions reject changes to the active project or workspace.
Release notes follow the active document theme and use the shared application button style.
Local document images use bounded loading and preview resolution, while PDF export requests higher resolution without modifying original assets.
You can reopen hidden release notes from About, as well as from the macOS application menu.
Installed betas recognize a verified promotion to stable in About, the footer and Preferences while preserving the selected update subscription, including offline recognition after verification.
Reopened document windows keep their size, position and monitor, and remain reachable when a display is disconnected.
File and folder rows now highlight with the active accent color on hover in the project navigator, search results, and welcome favorites and recents.
Opt into independent editor instances while Finder opens stay with the principal; document reservations and coordinated preference writes protect shared data.
Fix a crash before the first window when macOS cannot open the instance preferences suite.
Files and folders on locations without Trash can be permanently deleted after an explicit warning, while ordinary Trash errors continue to preserve the original item.
Updates close additional instances before downloading, preserve document and Git checks on Quit, and stop when an instance stays open. Automatic checks remain available; downloads require approval.
PDF export keeps working after switching between Preview and Split, including portable documents with local images and Mermaid diagrams.
Open MDLZ documents refresh after external changes; unsaved edits are protected with a choice to reload the disk version or save a copy.
Documents gain optional offline charts, citations and richer Markdown structures, with controls for global and project preferences.
PR evidence compilation counts are generated from the ledger and automatically checked for stale or inconsistent declarations.
Extension preferences show their state through the switch without a redundant caption.
Open embedded document images in a native window and save their original bytes from the image context menu.
The sidebar follows the active document, expands its folders and highlights its row. A new preference enables or disables this behavior and is on by default.
Recognize MDLZ packages in Finder and configure default opening for all Markdown and Leonardo formats.
Browse welcome favorites by category with horizontal tabs and scroll lists that show up to five items at once.
Project and workspace favorites can select their own theme, also applied when opening the same item from Recents, without changing other sessions or shared project settings.
Open project files in another tab from their context menu or with a double-click, retaining the project sidebar, and simplify navigation by removing workspace grouping.

Open an illustrated offline Leonardo guide in the interface language from Help or Welcome, with practice fields and agent setup. Synchronization now rejects suspended path operations before acquiring instance ownership.
Saving a copy of a conflicted MDLZ preserves its form answers and local resources in a complete package.

Adds detailed illustrated English and Spanish help with a feature coverage inventory and a feature-PR help maintenance convention, plus consent-based recommendations for disabled built-in extensions and resettable warnings.
Open a separate practice form from the English or Spanish user guide, ready to fill and save, while keeping help readable and previous answers intact.
Keep the active Leonardo file visibly selected and improve filename readability in dark appearance.
Insert images and reusable drawn rubrics with page placement, layer controls and a compact document toolbar.
Inspect placed images and rubrics in a native side panel, recolor inserted ink and dismiss object selection when returning to document text.
Open a bilingual guide from File → Import with your agent to convert PDFs into editable Leonardo documents with your own agent, with the same workflow included in the main help.
Keep selected saved documents available after closing LeonardoMD; manage the required background sync service from either device-sharing preferences screen.
Refresh the English and Spanish help with premium illustrations for document workflows, packages, export choices and agent-assisted import, while preserving the live Mermaid demonstrations.
Local app launches now check bundled dependencies and signing consistency before opening; disposable QA copies share the distribution signing order to prevent Sparkle loading failures.
Install and relaunch updates directly from Preferences, preserving unsaved-document and Git safety checks.

Adds protocol foundations for targeted Mac-to-iOS rubric requests without granting document editing. Capability negotiation, durable retries and pinned transport are ready; production UI/enrollment wiring remains deferred to #342.
Find sharing, device permissions and remote copies together in Synchronization, with separate pages for sharing from this Mac and connecting to other computers.
macOS targets one explicitly capable linked read-only peer, recovers requests by stable ID, reviews returned rubrics, and saves or inserts them safely. Legacy peers remain unsupported until #342.

iOS captures rubrics requested by a linked Mac with explicit consent, durable drafts, preview and HTTPS retry. Interrupted acceptance recovers safely and revoked links stay blocked after restart. Guides and Mac consent are available in English and Spanish.
Display formulas retain their TeX syntax, and both user guides include recurring math regression examples with mandatory help checks in tested app instances.

Adds owner-only iOS archive/export and Apple validation with canonical versioning, privacy metadata and branded assets; binds archives to clean committed source, documents #367's immutable rubric request identity, and keeps keychain signing process-scoped.
Help illustrations now blend into the document background with transparent Leonardo Classic artwork and localized captions, while new guide revisions preserve existing personal copies.
Extensible math symbols render complete shapes, and outline selections open the matching heading even when rendered content has different heights.
Little Leonardo includes an offline bilingual demo with format examples and a locally saved practice form.

Adds privacy-safe HTTPS diagnostics for iOS sync failures, preserving URL errors, pinning, redirects and bounds. A real TLS cutoff test checks partial byte counts; the alert and bilingual Guide v23 explain the code. Physical root cause remains unconfirmed.

Little Leonardo uses Classic colors and branded startup, adds offline About, help, privacy and license pages, and expands rubric drawing in landscape while restoring portrait controls without changing the drawing.
Shared-project HTTPS responses finish the TLS write stream before teardown, with bounded cleanup and privacy-safe server completion diagnostics.
Recover rubric status queries automatically while preserving request identity and access, and restore CI downloads with verified pinned Sparkle artifacts.

Reduces excess space before the first heading in Little Leonardo's synchronized Markdown reader. Desktop and later headings keep their spacing. Adds native iOS layout checks and updates both bundled guides.
Browse shared projects without bulk downloads, open files on demand, and manage temporary cache separately from files and folders kept offline.
Little Leonardo lists Demo alongside other projects, supports swipe-and-tap local project removal, and restores Demo from Settings while retaining practice answers.
Projects now show a common icon and distinguish local content, sharing from this device and content received from another device on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Automatically renew outdated sync services after Mac application updates while preserving device access and pending work.
Updates now pause the sharing service safely before replacing the Mac application, preserving existing access for the next launch. Installation waits if a safe stop cannot be confirmed.
Navigate synchronized folders and see only the files and folders in the current location.
Include the encryption compliance declaration in Little Leonardo builds.
Synchronization preferences keep their layout steady during refresh and show whether the service is checking, online, or unavailable beside the main switch.
Choose which detected built-in extensions to enable, suppress future recommendations globally, and reset warnings without changing activation preferences.

Added literal and regex search across open documents in this window, with highlights, counts and wrapping navigation. Applied premium fields to project search, commit and naming, switches to hidden-file controls, and joined preference tabs.
